verdict.rationale: Smooth's core product is an AI browser agent that takes plain-language task delegation. Examples include `smooth_client.run("Go to google flights and find the cheapest flight...")` and REST endpoints for running AI-powered tasks. Users can watch the agent live, take over, cancel tasks, and chain sequential tasks in sessions. One hands-on user reports a complex prompt worked well. Missing for 10: an in-product conversational or chat UI (delegation is only through the SDK, API or CLI), and independent corroboration beyond a single brief community report.
